desc_en: Arranges free lawyers for unaccompanied immigrant children in immigration court and gives them psychosocial support.
desc_es: Consigue abogados gratuitos para niños inmigrantes no acompañados en la corte de inmigración y les brinda apoyo psicosocial.
notes: No phone on homepage or contact page. Service languages not stated. IRS name "Kind Inc".

desc_en: Runs national legal defense programs for detained adults and unaccompanied children through a network of local legal service providers.
desc_es: Administra programas nacionales de defensa legal para adultos detenidos y niños no acompañados a través de una red de proveedores legales locales.
notes: Site © 2026 and lists current programs. Its federally funded programs (legal orientation, children's representation) have had funding disruptions; the site does not say which are running now. Press email only.

desc_en: Supports a national network of nonprofit (mostly Catholic) legal programs and works to increase representation for immigrants in detention and removal proceedings.
desc_es: Apoya una red nacional de programas legales sin fines de lucro (en su mayoría católicos) y trabaja para aumentar la representación de inmigrantes detenidos y en procesos de deportación.
notes: Homepage showed no 2026-dated items (trainings were 2025). The site loads and the EIN is current. Main office number, not a client hotline.

desc_en: Provides free and low-cost immigration legal services and social services to immigrants, including people in detention, mainly in Texas.
desc_es: Ofrece servicios legales de inmigración gratuitos o de bajo costo y servicios sociales a inmigrantes, incluidas personas detenidas, principalmente en Texas.
notes: Base is Texas; the site says it also works across the U.S. The pages I fetched did not mention a bond fund, so "bond" is left off. Many 2026 news items.

desc_en: Gives legal consultations and representation to low-income detained immigrants and litigates to get people out of detention.
desc_es: Brinda consultas y representación legal a inmigrantes detenidos de bajos recursos y litiga para sacar a personas de la detención.
notes: IRS name "Nijc Nfp" (Chicago), now independent of Heartland Alliance. Based in the Midwest, does national litigation. No phone on homepage.

desc_en: Places trained legal fellows at nonprofit host organizations across the country to provide immigration legal help.
desc_es: Coloca a becarios legales capacitados en organizaciones sin fines de lucro de todo el país para brindar ayuda legal de inmigración.
notes: Does not take cases directly; families reach help through host organizations. Says "nationwide"; 2026 Fall Training news.

desc_en: Runs a free national hotline for people in ICE detention and links callers to visitation groups, pen pals, and bond funds.
desc_es: Opera una línea gratuita nacional para personas detenidas por ICE y conecta a quienes llaman con grupos de visitas, amigos por correspondencia y fondos de fianza.
notes: Hotline Mon-Fri 8am-8pm PT; must be dialed from a facility phone. Its own national bond fund page (https://www.freedomforimmigrants.org/national-bond-fund) lists eligibility as bonds granted in CA or LA, or contact with an affiliated visitation program. That page has no 2026 date.

desc_en: National coalition that coordinates campaigns to end immigration detention and publishes information on detention conditions and deaths.
desc_es: Coalición nacional que coordina campañas para poner fin a la detención migratoria y publica información sobre condiciones y muertes en detención.
notes: No direct services to individuals. Press releases through Oct 26, 2026.

org: Young Center for Immigrant Children's Rights
desc_en: Assigns volunteer child advocates and staff to unaccompanied and separated immigrant children in government custody and advocates for their best interests.
desc_es: Asigna defensores voluntarios y personal a niños inmigrantes no acompañados o separados bajo custodia del gobierno y aboga por su interés superior.
notes: Offices in about 10 cities (Chicago, Houston, San Antonio, Harlingen, Phoenix, LA, NY, DC, NJ, Grand Rapids). Main office number.

desc_en: Researches and advocates on harms to women, children, and families from U.S. immigration policy, including tracking pregnant women in ICE custody.
desc_es: Investiga y aboga sobre los daños a mujeres, niños y familias causados por la política migratoria de EE. UU., incluido el seguimiento de mujeres embarazadas bajo custodia de ICE.
notes: Advocacy and research only; no direct legal services found.

desc_en: Provides free legal and social services to immigrant survivors of gender-based violence.
desc_es: Ofrece servicios legales y sociales gratuitos a sobrevivientes inmigrantes de violencia de género.
notes: The number is labeled "For help with your case." Offices in the DC area, Atlanta, Baltimore, Houston, and the SF Bay Area. es/fr appear only as help-link labels; service languages not stated.

desc_en: Gives free legal help to LGBTQ and HIV-positive immigrants, with a hotline for people in detention.
desc_es: Ofrece ayuda legal gratuita a inmigrantes LGBTQ y con VIH, con una línea para personas detenidas.
notes: Hotline takes calls only from people in detention; hours Mon/Wed 9:30-5:30, Tue 11-5:30.

phone: 510-380-8229 (collect line for people in prison and detention)
desc_en: Gives legal information and advocacy for transgender people, including trans immigrants in detention, through a collect line and migrant programs.
desc_es: Brinda información legal y defensa para personas transgénero, incluidos inmigrantes trans detenidos, mediante una línea de cobro revertido y programas para migrantes.
notes: Main line 510-587-9696. Its programs include the Black LGBTQIA+ Migrant Project and Border Butterflies.

desc_en: Faith-based agency offering refugee resettlement, asylum and border services, legal services, and children's services through U.S. offices.
desc_es: Agencia de fe que ofrece reasentamiento de refugiados, servicios de asilo y frontera, servicios legales y servicios para niños en oficinas de EE. UU.
notes: The homepage does not describe detention-specific services.

org: U.S. Conference of Catholic Bishops – Migration and Refugee Services
desc_en: Catholic bishops' office that runs migrant and refugee assistance programs, services for unaccompanied children, and the Justice for Immigrants advocacy campaign.
desc_es: Oficina de los obispos católicos que administra programas de ayuda a migrantes y refugiados, servicios para niños no acompañados y la campaña de defensa Justicia para Inmigrantes.
notes: Faith institution; no ProPublica EIN. The page says nothing on whether resettlement ended in 2025; I believe USCCB ended its federal resettlement agreement in 2025 but could not confirm it this session. No phone on page.

org: Global Refuge (formerly Lutheran Immigration and Refugee Service)
desc_en: Lutheran-founded agency offering resettlement, foster care and family reunification for immigrant children, legal services, and advocacy.
desc_es: Agencia de origen luterano que ofrece reasentamiento, cuidado temporal y reunificación familiar para niños inmigrantes, servicios legales y defensa.
notes: The number is unlabeled in the footer. IRS name is still Lutheran Immigration and Refugee Service.

desc_en: Jewish agency that offers U.S. immigration legal services and advocates for refugees and asylum seekers.
desc_es: Agencia judía que ofrece servicios legales de inmigración en EE. UU. y aboga por refugiados y solicitantes de asilo.
notes: The homepage only links to "Legal Services in the U.S."; I did not fetch that page. No phone listed (text line only).

desc_en: Helps refugees and immigrants resettle and get services through offices in more than 30 U.S. cities.
desc_es: Ayuda a refugiados e inmigrantes a reasentarse y acceder a servicios en oficinas de más de 30 ciudades de EE. UU.
notes: The U.S. page does not mention detention or legal services. Office phones are on local pages, which I did not fetch.

org: U.S. Committee for Refugees and Immigrants (USCRI)
desc_en: Provides legal, social, and health services to refugees, unaccompanied children, trafficking survivors, and other immigrants.
desc_es: Ofrece servicios legales, sociales y de salud a refugiados, niños no acompañados, sobrevivientes de trata y otros inmigrantes.
notes: The page also lists field-office numbers. No detention-specific services named.

desc_en: Membership group for asylum seekers that shares legal updates and guides on court, work permits, and asylum rules.
desc_es: Organización de membresía para solicitantes de asilo que comparte novedades legales y guías sobre la corte, permisos de trabajo y reglas de asilo.
notes: asylumadvocacy.org redirects here. The homepage does not mention detention.

org: Immigration Advocates Network – National Immigration Legal Services Directory
desc_en: Searchable directory of nonprofits giving free or low-cost immigration legal help, searchable by state, ZIP, or detention facility.
desc_es: Directorio de organizaciones sin fines de lucro que ofrecen ayuda legal de inmigración gratuita o de bajo costo, con búsqueda por estado, código postal o centro de detención.
notes: Joint project of IAN and Scale Justice; Pro Bono Net (EIN 06-1521179) powers the site. Not a 501(c) itself, so EIN left blank. Email only. ImmigrationLawHelp.org (Justicia Lab) is a similar directory.

org: Executive Office for Immigration Review (DOJ) – Pro Bono List and Case Status
desc_en: Federal immigration court agency that publishes a quarterly list of free legal service providers for each court and an online case-status lookup.
desc_es: Agencia federal de las cortes de inmigración que publica una lista trimestral de proveedores legales gratuitos por corte y una herramienta en línea para consultar el estado de un caso.
notes: Government body. List updated Sep 24, 2026. Case status at https://acis.eoir.justice.gov/en/ (en/es; needs A-number). 703-756-8020 is the List administrator.

desc_en: Publishes legal guides, red cards, and detention and habeas resources for immigrants and their advocates.
desc_es: Publica guías legales, tarjetas rojas y recursos sobre detención y hábeas corpus para inmigrantes y sus defensores.
notes: Mainly serves attorneys and advocates. Many Oct 2026 items. No phone on homepage.

desc_en: Supports lawyers and recruits pro bono attorneys to file habeas petitions for detained immigrants, including youth.
desc_es: Apoya a abogados y recluta abogados pro bono para presentar hábeas corpus a favor de inmigrantes detenidos, incluidos jóvenes.
notes: The number is the main office line, not a client line.

org: Community Justice Exchange – National Bail Fund Network
desc_en: Hosts a network of more than 90 community bail and bond funds, with a state-by-state directory that includes immigration bond funds.
desc_es: Coordina una red de más de 90 fondos comunitarios de fianza, con un directorio por estado que incluye fondos de fianza migratoria.
notes: Directory page has no 2026 date (latest dates are 2022), so some listings may be stale. Could not confirm the EIN or whether CJE is fiscally sponsored. Spanish page exists.

org: Center for Gender & Refugee Studies (UC Law San Francisco)
desc_en: University center giving free expert help and litigation support to lawyers representing asylum seekers, especially women, children, and LGBTQ+ people.
desc_es: Centro universitario que brinda ayuda experta gratuita y apoyo en litigios a abogados de solicitantes de asilo, sobre todo mujeres, niños y personas LGBTQ+.
notes: University program; helps attorneys, not individuals directly. News through Oct 23, 2026.

desc_en: National network that trains and supports advocates working with immigrant survivors of gender-based violence, including survivors facing removal.
desc_es: Red nacional que capacita y apoya a defensores que trabajan con sobrevivientes inmigrantes de violencia de género, incluidas quienes enfrentan deportación.
notes: Serves advocates and attorneys. Only "© 2026" on the page as an activity signal. IRS name "Asista Immigrant Assistance" (Glastonbury, CT).

desc_en: Partnership of faith organizations that teaches congregations and advocates on immigration and enforcement.
desc_es: Alianza de organizaciones de fe que educa a congregaciones y aboga sobre inmigración y control migratorio.
notes: A coalition, not a single 501(c); no EIN. Guide on responding to ICE enforcement dated Aug 6, 2026.

desc_en: Catholic Jesuit agency that serves and advocates for refugees and forcibly displaced people, including detention chaplaincy in the U.S.
desc_es: Agencia católica jesuita que sirve y aboga por refugiados y personas desplazadas, incluida capelanía en centros de detención en EE. UU.
notes: My detention chaplaincy page fetch failed, so that program is from prior knowledge and should be checked before saying it. DC office number.

desc_en: Youth-led network offering deportation-defense and know-your-rights resources and campaigning against ICE and CBP abuses.
desc_es: Red dirigida por jóvenes que ofrece recursos de defensa contra la deportación y de conozca sus derechos, y hace campaña contra abusos de ICE y CBP.
notes: The homepage did not show its hotline number. The EIN is for United We Dream Network Inc (likely the 501(c)(3)); United We Dream Action is 46-5216666. Page last modified Jan 2026.

desc_en: Publishes research on immigration enforcement and detention and brings litigation.
desc_es: Publica investigaciones sobre control migratorio y detención y presenta litigios.
notes: Main office number. Runs the Immigration Justice Campaign (next row).

desc_en: Connects volunteer lawyers and interpreters with immigrants facing deportation, including people in ICE detention.
desc_es: Conecta a abogados e intérpretes voluntarios con inmigrantes en riesgo de deportación, incluidas personas detenidas por ICE.
notes: Joint initiative of the American Immigration Council and AILA; no separate EIN. Email only. Only "© 2026" as an activity signal. Joint initiative of the American Immigration Council (EIN shown) and AILA (23-7085097).

desc_en: Publishes regularly updated data on ICE detention numbers, facilities, and immigration court cases.
desc_es: Publica datos actualizados sobre el número de personas detenidas por ICE, los centros de detención y los casos en las cortes de inmigración.
notes: Now TRAC Reports, Inc. (no longer at Syracuse University). Detention quick facts were current as of July 11, 2026.

desc_en: Nonpartisan think tank that publishes research and data on U.S. immigration, including enforcement and deportation.
desc_es: Centro de estudios no partidista que publica investigaciones y datos sobre la inmigración en EE. UU., incluidos el control migratorio y las deportaciones.
notes: Policy research, not detention-specific. Newest dated items I saw were June 2026.

desc_en: University project that obtains ICE records through FOIA lawsuits and publishes data on arrests, detentions, flights, and removals.
desc_es: Proyecto universitario que obtiene registros de ICE mediante demandas de FOIA y publica datos sobre arrestos, detenciones, vuelos y deportaciones.
notes: Latest ICE release covers through early March 2026 (https://deportationdata.org/data/ice.html).

desc_en: Provides legal representation for refugees and asylum seekers, litigates, and runs ICE Flight Monitor tracking deportation flights.
desc_es: Brinda representación legal a refugiados y solicitantes de asilo, litiga y opera ICE Flight Monitor, que rastrea vuelos de deportación.
notes: Refugee protection is a core program, though the organization covers other human-rights work too. ICE Flight Monitor items dated Oct 19, 2026.

desc_en: Connects Black and Haitian migrants with humanitarian, legal, and social services and advocates for fair immigration policy.
desc_es: Conecta a migrantes negros y haitianos con servicios humanitarios, legales y sociales y aboga por una política migratoria justa.
notes: Hotline Mon-Fri 10am-7pm EST. Direct services are mainly in San Diego and Tijuana; advocacy is national. Detention services are not named. Service languages not stated (Kreyòl likely, unverified).

desc_en: Evangelical agency offering refugee resettlement, immigration programs, and advocacy through U.S. offices.
desc_es: Agencia evangélica que ofrece reasentamiento de refugiados, programas de inmigración y defensa en oficinas de EE. UU.
notes: Homepage gives no phone and does not describe detention-specific services.

desc_en: National resettlement agency that helps refugees and newcomers settle and connect to local services.
desc_es: Agencia nacional de reasentamiento que ayuda a refugiados y recién llegados a establecerse y conectarse con servicios locales.
notes: Not detention-specific. Activity signal is weak (© 2026; page modified May 2026).

desc_en: Provides legal and humanitarian help to migrants, deportees, and separated families in the U.S. and Mexico.
desc_es: Brinda ayuda legal y humanitaria a migrantes, personas deportadas y familias separadas en EE. UU. y México.
notes: Binational, mainly California and Tijuana. Unlabeled number. News page has items through June 2026.

desc_en: Nonprofit newsroom covering immigration, including ICE detention and how to contact a detained loved one.
desc_es: Medio periodístico sin fines de lucro que cubre la inmigración, incluida la detención de ICE y cómo contactar a un ser querido detenido.
notes: NYC-focused (would fit a regional list). Calls itself a nonprofit newsroom. Possible ProPublica match "Documented Ltd" 83-3036502, not confirmed, so EIN left blank.

desc_en: Nonprofit newsroom covering immigration policy and ICE enforcement, with Spanish-language editions.
desc_es: Medio periodístico sin fines de lucro que cubre la política migratoria y las operaciones de ICE, con ediciones en español.
notes: Chicago and Midwest focus (would fit a regional list). Stories through Oct 27, 2026.

desc_en: Nonpartisan group that advocates for practical immigration policy and publishes explainers on enforcement and immigrant rights.
desc_es: Grupo no partidista que aboga por políticas migratorias prácticas y publica explicaciones sobre control migratorio y derechos de los inmigrantes.
notes: immigrationforum.org redirects to forumtogether.org. Newest items I saw were April 2026. No direct services.

desc_en: Advocacy group working on immigration and criminal justice reform, including research on 287(g) ICE partnerships.
desc_es: Grupo de defensa que trabaja en reformas de inmigración y justicia penal, incluidas investigaciones sobre los acuerdos 287(g) con ICE.
notes: FWD.us Inc. is a 501(c)(4); the EIN is for its 501(c)(3), FWD.us Education Fund. Immigration is one of its two core issues. No direct services.

org: National Network for Immigrant & Refugee Rights
desc_en: National coalition that advocates for immigrants and refugees and opposes new detention facilities, including family detention.
desc_es: Coalición nacional que aboga por inmigrantes y refugiados y se opone a nuevos centros de detención, incluida la detención de familias.
notes: EIN not confirmed (ProPublica search returned nothing). No direct services. Many 2026 items.

desc_en: Federal online tool for finding a person currently held in ICE detention, by A-number or by name and country of birth.
desc_es: Herramienta federal en línea para encontrar a una persona detenida por ICE, con el número A o con su nombre y país de nacimiento.
notes: Government body. The page loads but renders by JavaScript, so I could not read its text; search fields are from general knowledge. ice.gov blocked my fetches. The ICE ERO Detention Reporting and Information Line 1 (888) 351-4024 appears on the DHS OIG page, not an ICE page, so it is left out of the phone field.

org: DHS Office of Inspector General Hotline
desc_en: Federal watchdog hotline for reporting misconduct or civil rights abuses by DHS staff, including in ICE detention.
desc_es: Línea federal de supervisión para denunciar mala conducta o abusos de derechos civiles por personal del DHS, incluso en la detención de ICE.
notes: Government body; no "government" type exists, so types are approximate. TTY 1-844-889-4357. Not for emergencies; the page says to call 911 for immediate danger.

org: RAICES (Refugee and Immigrant Center for Education and Legal Services)
desc_en: Provides free and low-cost immigration legal services in Texas, including a Detained Family Defense program for detained children and caregivers and help with bond cases.
desc_es: Ofrece servicios legales de inmigración gratuitos y de bajo costo en Texas, incluido un programa de defensa para familias detenidas (niños y cuidadores) y ayuda en casos de fianza.
notes: The consultation line covers its San Antonio, Austin, Corpus Christi, DFW and Houston offices. A rural line, +1 (800) 490-2606, is for crime/trafficking/DV survivors. The site's news covers Dilley but no page says RAICES serves a specific facility. Its legal services are "free and low-cost".

desc_en: An El Paso nonprofit giving free and low-cost legal services to low-income immigrants in West Texas and New Mexico, and speaking out on detention such as the Fort Bliss camp.
desc_es: Organización sin fines de lucro de El Paso que ofrece servicios legales gratuitos y de bajo costo a inmigrantes de bajos ingresos en el oeste de Texas y Nuevo México, y denuncia la detención, como el campamento de Fort Bliss.
notes: The homepage doesn't describe detained-client services directly. Its service area also includes Ciudad Juárez.

desc_en: Provides deportation defense for detained and non-detained adults and unaccompanied children in the Houston-Galveston area.
desc_es: Brinda defensa contra la deportación a adultos detenidos y no detenidos y a niños no acompañados en la zona de Houston-Galveston.
notes: The site doesn't name detention centers.

desc_en: An Austin shelter where most residents come straight from detention centers; it offers housing, food, clothing, English classes and links to legal and medical help, plus Posada Esperanza for women and children.
desc_es: Albergue en Austin donde la mayoría de los residentes llegan directamente de centros de detención; ofrece vivienda, comida, ropa, clases de inglés y acceso a ayuda legal y médica, además de Posada Esperanza para mujeres y niños.
notes: The site doesn't name the detention centers.

org: Estrella del Paso (formerly Diocesan Migrant & Refugee Services)
desc_en: A ministry of the Catholic Diocese of El Paso that gives free immigration legal services to migrants and refugees in West Texas and New Mexico.
desc_es: Ministerio de la Diócesis Católica de El Paso que ofrece servicios legales de inmigración gratuitos a migrantes y refugiados en el oeste de Texas y Nuevo México.
notes: dmrs-ep.org redirects here. Its pages don't mention detention, and its unaccompanied children's program has closed. I didn't confirm a separate EIN; it may fall under the diocese.

desc_en: A Catholic-rooted volunteer house of hospitality in El Paso that shelters migrants, immigrants and refugees.
desc_es: Casa de hospitalidad de voluntarios en El Paso, inspirada en la doctrina social católica, que da albergue a migrantes, inmigrantes y refugiados.
notes: The homepage doesn't mention released detainees and shows no phone number.

org: University of Texas School of Law Immigration Clinic
desc_en: Supervised law students represent low-income immigrants, with a main focus on detention and deportation defense and asylum.
desc_es: Estudiantes de derecho supervisados representan a inmigrantes de bajos ingresos, con enfoque principal en la defensa ante la detención y la deportación y en casos de asilo.
notes: The phone is the law school's main line, not a clinic intake line. The page doesn't name detention centers.

desc_en: A New Orleans group founded to fill the gap in legal help for people held in Louisiana's immigration detention centers.
desc_es: Organización de Nueva Orleans creada para cubrir la falta de ayuda legal para las personas recluidas en los centros de detención de inmigrantes de Luisiana.
notes: The site doesn't name detention centers.

org: Louisiana Advocates for Immigrants in Detention (LaAID)
desc_en: A mostly volunteer statewide group that visits and writes to people in 10 Louisiana detention centers and 1 in Mississippi, gives families resource materials, and helps released people with rides, meals and overnight hosting.
desc_es: Grupo estatal, mayormente de voluntarios, que visita y escribe a personas en 10 centros de detención de Luisiana y 1 de Misisipi, da materiales de apoyo a las familias y ayuda a las personas liberadas con transporte, comida y alojamiento por una noche.
notes: The site says it has no voice line ("we don't have the capacity to receive calls") and that it is not attorneys. Its email is LaAID@proton.me. The site doesn't name the facilities.

desc_en: A New Orleans grassroots nonprofit whose volunteer groups visit people in rural Louisiana immigration jails, support release through sponsorship, and serve as long-term support networks after release.
desc_es: Organización comunitaria sin fines de lucro de Nueva Orleans cuyos grupos de voluntarios visitan a personas en las cárceles de inmigración rurales de Luisiana, apoyan su liberación mediante patrocinio y las acompañan a largo plazo.
notes: The site shows no phone number and its contact page failed to load.

org: ACLU of Louisiana – Immigrant Rights Project
desc_en: Works with law firms and law school clinics to give free legal help to people in Louisiana immigration detention (parole applications, habeas petitions, civil rights complaints) and documents detention conditions, including at Pine Prairie.
desc_es: Colabora con bufetes y clínicas de derecho para dar ayuda legal gratuita a personas detenidas por inmigración en Luisiana (solicitudes de parole, habeas corpus, quejas de derechos civiles) y documenta las condiciones de detención, incluida Pine Prairie.
notes: This is a program of a broader civil-liberties group. The ACLU of LA itself is a 501(c)(4); the Foundation is the c3, and I couldn't get its EIN. The page lists no intake phone.

org: Catholic Charities Archdiocese of New Orleans
desc_en: A Catholic agency whose Immigration & Refugee Services offer legal representation, counseling and refugee resettlement.
desc_es: Agencia católica cuyos Servicios de Inmigración y Refugiados ofrecen representación legal, asesoría y reasentamiento de refugiados.
notes: This is the general "Need help" line. The site doesn't mention detention. Weaker fit.

desc_en: A free deportation defense law firm in Southern California that represents detained adults and children and posts guides for families, including how to challenge detention at Adelanto and Desert View Annex.
desc_es: Despacho de defensa contra la deportación, gratuito, en el sur de California, que representa a adultos y niños detenidos y publica guías para familias, como impugnar la detención en Adelanto y Desert View Annex.
notes: The site says its services are always free.

desc_en: A Bay Area nonprofit offering free or low-cost deportation defense and running a 24/7 hotline for immigrants at risk of deportation.
desc_es: Organización del Área de la Bahía que ofrece defensa contra la deportación gratuita o de bajo costo y opera una línea de ayuda 24/7 para inmigrantes en riesgo de deportación.
notes: The hotline number isn't printed on the homepage. The site doesn't name facilities.

desc_en: Provides legal help and advocacy for people in California immigration detention and monitors conditions at Mesa Verde and Golden State Annex.
desc_es: Brinda ayuda legal y defensa a personas en detención migratoria en California y vigila las condiciones en Mesa Verde y Golden State Annex.
notes: The site shows no phone; email is info@ccijustice.org.

desc_en: A statewide interfaith nonprofit that runs accompaniment teams and a pro se legal orientation program, and organizes faith visits to Kern County ICE detention facilities.
desc_es: Organización interreligiosa estatal que tiene equipos de acompañamiento y un programa de orientación legal para quienes se representan solos, y organiza visitas de fe a centros de detención de ICE en el condado de Kern.
notes: The site says the Kern County visit pilgrimage is postponed. It shows no phone.

desc_en: A San Francisco legal group that may offer free consultations and representation on immigration detention and deportation, including resources for Southeast Asian refugees facing deportation.
desc_es: Organización legal de San Francisco que puede ofrecer consultas y representación gratuitas sobre detención y deportación, incluidos recursos para refugiados del sudeste asiático en riesgo de deportación.
notes: The site says services are offered "in some cases".

desc_en: A Los Angeles project of Catholic Charities of Los Angeles offering community education, direct legal representation and pro bono programs for immigrants.
desc_es: Proyecto de Caridades Católicas de Los Ángeles que ofrece educación comunitaria, representación legal directa y programas pro bono para inmigrantes.
notes: The site doesn't say whether it serves detained people. I didn't look up an EIN; it would be Catholic Charities of LA's.

desc_en: Accompanies people held at Stewart Detention Center and their families, supports visits, and runs a free hospitality house in Lumpkin, GA, for visiting relatives.
desc_es: Acompaña a las personas recluidas en el Centro de Detención Stewart y a sus familias, apoya las visitas y tiene una casa de hospitalidad gratuita en Lumpkin, GA, para los familiares que las visitan.
notes: The EIN match is by name and state only; the site doesn't print its EIN. Visitors must call first to get the house address.

org: Georgia Latino Alliance for Human Rights (GLAHR)
desc_en: An Atlanta community nonprofit offering a hotline, know-your-rights sessions and family preparedness plans; it has pressed for accountability over abuse at the Folkston ICE Processing Center.
desc_es: Organización comunitaria de Atlanta que ofrece una línea de ayuda, talleres de "conozca sus derechos" y planes de preparación familiar; ha exigido rendición de cuentas por abusos en el Centro de Procesamiento de ICE en Folkston.
notes: The site doesn't describe services for detained people directly. The hotline runs Mon–Fri 9–5.

desc_en: An Atlanta movement group that documents conditions and campaigns to close Georgia immigration detention centers, including Stewart and Irwin County.
desc_es: Organización de Atlanta que documenta las condiciones y hace campaña para cerrar centros de detención de inmigrantes en Georgia, como Stewart e Irwin County.
notes: Advocacy only, no direct services. The site shows no phone.

desc_en: Provides free immigration legal services to asylum seekers and survivors of violence in Georgia.
desc_es: Ofrece servicios legales de inmigración gratuitos a solicitantes de asilo y sobrevivientes de violencia en Georgia.
notes: The homepage doesn't mention detention.

desc_en: Provides immigration legal services, free legal clinics and know-your-rights help, and advocates around the Folkston detention center.
desc_es: Ofrece servicios legales de inmigración, clínicas legales gratuitas y orientación sobre derechos, y aboga en torno al centro de detención de Folkston.
notes: The homepage shows no phone. The listed languages are for its election pages.

desc_en: Provides free legal education, representation and social services to adults and children held in immigration detention in Arizona.
desc_es: Ofrece educación legal, representación y servicios sociales gratuitos a adultos y niños en detención migratoria en Arizona.
notes: The homepage doesn't name facilities. It also publishes a widely used bond guide.

desc_en: A Catholic-rooted group in Nogales that gives food, shelter, first aid, clothing and accompaniment to people deported to Nogales, Sonora, and documents abuse.
desc_es: Organización de raíz católica en Nogales que da comida, albergue, primeros auxilios, ropa y acompañamiento a personas deportadas a Nogales, Sonora, y documenta abusos.
notes: Post-deportation help, not detention.

desc_en: A Miami nonprofit law firm that monitors and challenges immigration detention practices in Florida and helps detained asylum seekers through volunteers.
desc_es: Despacho legal sin fines de lucro de Miami que vigila e impugna las prácticas de detención migratoria en Florida y ayuda a solicitantes de asilo detenidos mediante voluntarios.
notes: The pages I fetched don't name Krome or other facilities.

desc_en: A statewide coalition with a free hotline, legal resource referrals and know-your-rights information for Florida immigrants.
desc_es: Coalición estatal con una línea gratuita, referencias a recursos legales e información sobre derechos para inmigrantes en Florida.
notes: The site doesn't describe detention services.

org: Catholic Legal Services, Archdiocese of Miami
desc_en: A Catholic legal agency offering removal defense, asylum and other immigration help from offices in Miami and Hollywood, FL.
desc_es: Agencia legal católica que ofrece defensa contra la deportación, asilo y otra ayuda migratoria en sus oficinas de Miami y Hollywood, FL.
notes: The site doesn't mention Krome. It may charge low fees.

desc_en: An Albuquerque nonprofit legal center with detention programs (including detention letters) for people held in New Mexico.
desc_es: Centro legal sin fines de lucro de Albuquerque con programas de detención (incluidas cartas a personas detenidas) para quienes están recluidos en Nuevo México.
notes: The detention program page failed to load, so I couldn't confirm details or facilities.

org: El CENTRO de Igualdad y Derechos
desc_en: An Albuquerque grassroots immigrants' and workers' rights group.
desc_es: Organización comunitaria de Albuquerque por los derechos de inmigrantes y trabajadores.
notes: It has no detention-specific services. I included it as a community contact.

desc_en: A statewide immigrant-led group in New Mexico offering know-your-rights resources and immigrant-rights campaigns.
desc_es: Organización estatal dirigida por inmigrantes en Nuevo México que ofrece recursos sobre derechos y campañas por los derechos de los inmigrantes.
notes: No detention services or phone on its homepage.

desc_en: A Jackson-based alliance working on legal resources, health access, fair labor and know-your-rights education for immigrants in Mississippi.
desc_es: Alianza con sede en Jackson que trabaja en recursos legales, acceso a la salud, trabajo justo y educación sobre derechos para inmigrantes en Misisipi.
notes: Its pages don't mention detention or Adams County.

desc_en: A Mississippi nonprofit with United Methodist roots offering low-cost humanitarian and family-based immigration legal services from Biloxi, Forest and Columbus.
desc_es: Organización de Misisipi de raíz metodista que ofrece servicios legales de inmigración humanitarios y familiares a bajo costo en Biloxi, Forest y Columbus.
notes: It charges low fees for legal work (not for freeing anyone). The site doesn't mention detention.

org: First Friends of New Jersey and New York
desc_en: Volunteers visit and write to detained immigrants; it runs a helpline for detained people and families, funds commissary and phone time, makes bond referrals, and helps with housing, transport and food after release.
desc_es: Voluntarios visitan y escriben a inmigrantes detenidos; tiene una línea de ayuda para personas detenidas y sus familias, cubre gastos de comisaría y llamadas, hace referencias para fianzas y ayuda con vivienda, transporte y comida tras la liberación.
notes: The site doesn't name facilities. The helpline runs 10am–4pm.

org: Wind of the Spirit Immigrant Resource Center
desc_en: A Madison, NJ resource center led by people of faith who are directly affected by immigration; it offers know-your-rights workshops and materials.
desc_es: Centro de recursos en Madison, NJ, dirigido por personas de fe directamente afectadas por la inmigración, que ofrece talleres y materiales sobre derechos.
notes: windofthespirit.net redirects to wotsnj.org. The site doesn't mention detention services.

desc_en: A community organization that represents immigrants in a range of cases (asylum, U/T visas, family petitions, DACA) and gives know-your-rights trainings.
desc_es: Organización comunitaria que representa a inmigrantes en diversos casos (asilo, visas U/T, peticiones familiares, DACA) y da talleres sobre derechos.
notes: The site doesn't mention detention. The ProPublica lookup failed, so the EIN is blank.

org: New Jersey Office of New Americans (NJ Dept. of Human Services)
desc_en: A state office that supports immigrants with outreach, access to services and legal services, including the state's Detention and Deportation Defense Initiative.
desc_es: Oficina estatal que apoya a los inmigrantes con orientación, acceso a servicios y servicios legales, incluida la Iniciativa de Defensa ante la Detención y la Deportación del estado.
notes: The DDDI page itself failed to load, so I couldn't confirm details or providers.

org: Envision Freedom Fund (formerly Brooklyn Community Bail Fund)
desc_en: Pays immigration bonds, runs an immigration hotline, and gives post-release support and bond-posting instructions.
desc_es: Paga fianzas de inmigración, tiene una línea de ayuda migratoria y ofrece apoyo tras la liberación e instrucciones para pagar fianzas.
notes: The hotline number isn't printed on the homepage. Its service area isn't stated.

desc_en: One of three NYIFUP providers, giving free deportation defense, including custody (bond) hearings, to detained noncitizens.
desc_es: Uno de los tres proveedores de NYIFUP; ofrece defensa gratuita contra la deportación a personas detenidas, incluidas audiencias de custodia (fianza).
notes: Public defender with a broader practice; immigration is a major unit.

org: The Legal Aid Society (NYC) – Immigration Law Unit
desc_en: A NYIFUP partner that represents New Yorkers in federal immigration detention facing deportation and files habeas cases against prolonged ICE detention.
desc_es: Socio de NYIFUP que representa a neoyorquinos en detención migratoria federal que enfrentan la deportación y presenta habeas corpus contra detenciones prolongadas de ICE.
notes: Its general line, not a detention hotline.

org: Prisoners' Legal Services of New York – Immigration
desc_en: Represents noncitizens in New York State prisons who are in removal proceedings; a Rapid Response Unit serves people detained or facing detention in the North Country.
desc_es: Representa a personas no ciudadanas en prisiones del estado de Nueva York que están en proceso de deportación; una Unidad de Respuesta Rápida atiende a personas detenidas o en riesgo de detención en el North Country.
notes: It sued DHS over attorney access at the Buffalo ICE facility. Its pages don't describe Batavia intake.

desc_en: A Buffalo group running a hotline for people held at the Batavia ICE detention center, pen pals and books for detainees, accompaniment, and support when people are released.
desc_es: Grupo de Buffalo con una línea de ayuda para personas recluidas en el centro de detención de ICE en Batavia, amigos por correspondencia y libros, acompañamiento y apoyo al ser liberadas.
notes: The site doesn't mention bond.

desc_en: An umbrella coalition of 200+ immigrant groups offering know-your-rights and legal-provider resources and campaigning for access to representation.
desc_es: Coalición de más de 200 grupos de inmigrantes que ofrece recursos sobre derechos y proveedores legales y aboga por el acceso a representación.
notes: Advocacy and referral only.

desc_en: A York-based legal nonprofit giving free representation to immigrants in detention and teaching detained people their rights.
desc_es: Organización legal con sede en York que ofrece representación gratuita a inmigrantes detenidos y les enseña sus derechos.
notes: The site doesn't name facilities.

desc_en: Provides legal and social services to low-income immigrants and refugees in Pennsylvania.
desc_es: Ofrece servicios legales y sociales a inmigrantes y refugiados de bajos ingresos en Pensilvania.
notes: The EIN is uncertain. ProPublica also lists "Pennsylvania HIAS Indigent Immigrant Legal Services" (61-1697848). The homepage doesn't mention detention. Appointment only.

desc_en: A Philadelphia agency offering legal, health, survivor and youth services to immigrants and refugees.
desc_es: Agencia de Filadelfia que ofrece servicios legales, de salud, para sobrevivientes y para jóvenes a inmigrantes y refugiados.
notes: The site doesn't mention detention.

desc_en: A South Philadelphia Latine immigrant community group with immigrant-justice and community-care programs and a Moshannon Valley Support Network campaign.
desc_es: Organización comunitaria latina de inmigrantes en el sur de Filadelfia con programas de justicia migratoria y cuidado comunitario y una campaña de apoyo a Moshannon Valley.
notes: The site doesn't describe what the Moshannon network does. The EIN match is by name and state.

desc_en: A statewide coalition sharing rapid-response and anti-ICE resources and campaigning to shut down detention.
desc_es: Coalición estatal que comparte recursos de respuesta rápida y frente a ICE y hace campaña para cerrar la detención.
notes: Advocacy only. The site now uses the name "Pennsylvania Immigration Coalition".

desc_en: Runs a Legal Orientation Program and direct representation for people held at the Northwest Detention Center in Tacoma; families can leave the detained person's name and A-number on its detention line.
desc_es: Ofrece un programa de orientación legal y representación directa para personas en el Centro de Detención del Noroeste en Tacoma; las familias pueden dejar en su línea de detención el nombre y el número A de la persona detenida.
notes: Detained referrals also go to detainedreferrals@nwirp.org.

org: Advocates for Immigrants in Detention Northwest (AIDNW)
desc_en: Volunteers visit and write to people at the Northwest ICE Processing Center and fund their phone calls; a Welcome Center outside the facility gives released people clothes, food, phones, travel help and short-term housing.
desc_es: Voluntarios visitan y escriben a personas en el Centro de Procesamiento de ICE del Noroeste y pagan sus llamadas; un Centro de Bienvenida frente al lugar da a las personas liberadas ropa, comida, teléfono, ayuda para viajar y alojamiento temporal.

desc_en: Runs a statewide deportation defense hotline, the Fair Fight Bond Fund, and volunteer accompaniment to check-ins and hearings.
desc_es: Opera una línea estatal de defensa contra la deportación, el fondo de fianzas Fair Fight y acompañamiento de voluntarios a citas y audiencias.
notes: The hotline runs Mon–Fri 7am–2pm.

desc_en: A DOJ-accredited Tacoma organization offering immigration help from multilingual staff.
desc_es: Organización de Tacoma acreditada por el Departamento de Justicia que ofrece ayuda migratoria con personal multilingüe.
notes: The site doesn't mention detention.

desc_en: Provides free legal and social services to immigrant children and to adults held at the Denver Contract Detention Facility in Aurora.
desc_es: Ofrece servicios legales y sociales gratuitos a niños inmigrantes y a adultos recluidos en el Centro de Detención por Contrato de Denver, en Aurora.
notes: The detention hotline is for detained people and their families.

desc_en: A statewide coalition running a 24/7 bilingual ICE activity hotline, know-your-rights trainings and legal workshops; it pushed for Colorado's legal defense fund and is suing over a planned Hudson detention center.
desc_es: Coalición estatal con una línea bilingüe 24/7 para reportar actividad de ICE, talleres sobre derechos y talleres legales; impulsó el fondo de defensa legal de Colorado y demanda por un centro de detención planeado en Hudson.

desc_en: An Aurora group whose volunteers visit people held at the Aurora detention facility and welcome people when they are released, free of charge.
desc_es: Grupo de Aurora cuyos voluntarios visitan a personas recluidas en el centro de detención de Aurora y reciben a quienes son liberados, sin costo.
notes: The site says its text line (720.899.1838) has problems.

desc_en: A Denver 501(c)(3) bond fund that pays immigration bonds for people held at the Aurora ICE facility (by online application) and links people to post-release resources.
desc_es: Fondo de fianzas 501(c)(3) en Denver que paga fianzas de inmigración para personas en el centro de ICE en Aurora (mediante solicitud en línea) y conecta a recursos tras la liberación.
notes: Minimum bond $1,500. No phone; email is info@immigrantfreedomfund.org.

org: Illinois Coalition for Immigrant and Refugee Rights (ICIRR)
desc_en: Its Family Support Hotline helps families locate a detained relative and reach an immigration lawyer, and it runs Court Watch at Chicago Immigration Court.
desc_es: Su línea de apoyo familiar ayuda a las familias a localizar a un familiar detenido y conseguir abogado de inmigración, y organiza observación de audiencias en la Corte de Inmigración de Chicago.
notes: Illinois bans immigrant detention in the state; detained Illinois residents are often held in WI, IN or KY.

org: Illinois Community for Displaced Immigrants (ICDI, formerly Interfaith Community for Detained Immigrants)
desc_en: A Chicago group giving essentials, case management and housing to displaced immigrants, including people who would otherwise face detention.
desc_es: Grupo de Chicago que da artículos básicos, gestión de casos y vivienda a inmigrantes desplazados, incluidas personas que de otro modo enfrentarían la detención.
notes: CauseIQ lists EIN 46-1374353, but ProPublica failed. The faith link is historical (per MacArthur Foundation); the current site doesn't mention faith or Broadview.

desc_en: A Chicago group with a support hotline for people facing deportation; it fights deportation cases with attorneys and volunteers and helps families plan for an ICE detention.
desc_es: Grupo de Chicago con una línea de apoyo para personas que enfrentan deportación; lucha casos con abogados y voluntarios y ayuda a las familias a prepararse ante una detención de ICE.
notes: Its hotline number is the same one ICIRR lists.
